text:
sara.sales: Procurement from HealthNova asked for a tiny assurance packet to close: SOC2 excerpts, ISO scope note, signed pen-test attestation (one page), redacted staging network sketch, and note on KMS tenant separation. Also asked if Dedicated + customer KMS affects price. Need a one-paragraph reply.
ben.security: We can supply redacted SOC2 excerpts and the ISO scope statement. Pen-test: we provide a one-page attestation signed by security lead; we won't share full reports. For KMS, we can provide a short architecture note describing tenant separation and HSM usage at a high level.
eva.devops: If they need vulnerability scans against staging we can create ephemeral creds + presigned upload with 7d TTL. On-prem scanning requires SOW + legal/ops approval. Presign naming: `healthnova_evidence/<artifact>-YYYYMMDD.pdf`.
sara.sales: Any ETA and pricing blurb I should include?
ben.security: ETA: 2-3 business days for the packet, pen-test signature may take up to 7 business days for legal sign-off. Pricing: Dedicated + customer KMS typically moves to Enterprise tier (platform fee) plus Dedicated commitment; expect a one-time integration fee. Mark numbers "subject to RevOps confirmation."
ops-bot: evidence-upload-bucket created: https://presign.redwood/uploads/healthnova_evidence/ (expires in 7d).
legal-bot: pen-test-attestation-template.pdf available at https://redwood.internal/evidence/pen-test-attestation-template.pdf (uploader: legal-bot).
sara.sales: Draft to send to procurement: "We can assemble a compact evidence packet (SOC2 excerpt, ISO scope, signed pen-test attestation, redacted network sketch, and KMS separation note) within ~3 business days. Pen-test attestation signature may take up to 7 business days. Enabling Dedicated with customer-managed KMS typically requires Enterprise tier licensing (platform fee), a Dedicated commitment, and a one-time integration charge; we'll confirm exact pricing with RevOps. If scanning access is needed, we can provide ephemeral staging credentials and a presigned upload link (7-day TTL). We do not provide full pen-test reports or raw internal logs"
eva.devops: I'll upload the redacted diagram to the presigned path and ping when done.
ben.security: LGTM. Ping me if they ask for report access; we'll decline and offer attestation/remediation summary.
